## Pinless Debit

- [Overview](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/pinless-debit/optimized-debit-routing/overview/): Optimized debit routing routes eligible debit cards through lower-cost PINless debit networks.
- [Eligibility](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/pinless-debit/optimized-debit-routing/eligibility/): Reach out to your Technical account manager to get enabled for PINless or
- [Integration](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/pinless-debit/optimized-debit-routing/integration/): Note For managing your authorization workflow for transactions routed on debit networks, see
- [Managing authorization](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/pinless-debit/optimized-debit-routing/managing-authorization/): Following are some options and limitations to know when managing your authorization workflow for transactions routed to debit networks.
- [Network response codes](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/pinless-debit/optimized-debit-routing/network-response-codes/): In addition to the [processor response code](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/reference/response/transaction/ruby#processor_response_code)and text, some transaction…
- [Test and go live](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/pinless-debit/optimized-debit-routing/test-and-go-live/): If a transaction routed to the debit network is not successful, Braintree can retry the transaction over Visa or Mastercard networks.
- [Fetch the routed debit network of a transaction](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/pinless-debit/optimized-debit-routing/code-samples/sdk/ruby/): For transactions routed on debit networks, “debit network” field will be populated in the response object during the authorization step and, will be available for subsequent…
